claims.claim: Children reach compulsory school age when starting Reception at age 4 to 5
claims.quote: Your child must start full-time education once they reach compulsory school age. This is on 31 December, 31 March or 31 August following their fifth birthday
claims.note: Compulsory school age follows the fifth birthday; starting Reception after the fourth birthday is customary but earlier.

claims.claim: Most children start Reception at age 4 to 5
claims.quote: Most children start reception full-time in September after their fourth birthday.
claims.note: The usual Reception starting age is supported.

claims.claim: Children start secondary school at age 11
claims.note: The sources discuss secondary applications but do not state an age of 11 for starting secondary school.

claims.claim: Proof of address is needed for a school place application
claims.quote: You may need to: supply proof of your new address, for example a mortgage or rental agreement or deeds for the property
claims.note: Address proof may be requested when applying from another country, but the source does not make it universal.
